v1.22.1a (20 May 2024) |feed_title = 👊 Brawler Tower 👊 |previous_update = [[v1.21.0|Consumables Update]] |next_update = [[v1.23.0|The Classic Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.22.0''' is the seventy-fifth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 18th of May 2024. This update was also given the name '''Brawler Update''', as this update added the [[Brawler]] tower. This update encompassed three updates, the main '''v1.22.0''' update (18 May 2024) and three minor updates, v1.22.1 (20 May 2024) and v1.22.1a (20 May 2024). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Brawler]] ===Maps=== *[[PVP (Map)|PVP]] ===Skins=== *New skin for the [[Vigilante Crate]] **[[Commander]]: {{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} *New skin for the [[Premium Crate]] **[[Commander]]: {{Color|Premium|Pattern}} ===Miscellaneous=== *[[PVP Test]] ==Removals== :In '''v1.22.1a''' *[[PVP Test]] *Removed PVP statue from lobby. ==Changes and Bugfixes== *[[Commander]] buffed. **Placement limit increased from 3 to 4. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 2''' ****''Call to Arms'' cooldown decreased from 40 to 30. ***'''Level 4''' ****''Support Caravan'' cost decreased from {{Money|3,000}} increased from 3 to 4. ***'''Level 2''' ****Level 0 [[Grenadier]] damage increased from 25 to 30. ****Level 0 [[Grenadier]] explosion range increased from 3 to 3.5. ***'''Level 3''' ****Level 1 unlocks the [[Riot Guard]] instead of the [[Field Medic]]. ****Name changed from ''Field Team Medic'' to ''Riot Control''. ***'''Level 5''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|17,500}} to {{Money|15,000}}. ****Now unlocks the [[Field Medic]] instead of the [[Riot Guard]]. ****Level 0 [[Field Medic]] max targets increased from 3 to 4. ***'''Level 6''' ****Level 2 [[Rifleman]] damage increased from 10 to 12. ****Level 2 [[Grenadier]] damage decreased from 85 to 65. ****Level 2 [[Grenadier]] explosion range increased from 4.5 to 6. ****Level 1 [[Field Medic]] max targets increased from 4 to 8. *[[Boss]] enemies are now immune to knockback. *[[VIP+]] perks changed. **Now gives a 20% {{Coins|Coins}} boost. **Now gives a 20% {{Gem|Gems}} boost. **In-game friends now receive 10% boost to {{Exp|}}, {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}}. **Now gives the [[VIPPlus Nametag]] upon first purchase. **Now gives one [[Deluxe Crate]] on every purchase and two on first purchase. **[[High Grade Crate]]s increased from 2 to 4 on every purchase and from 2 to 6 on first purchase. **[[Currencies#Time Scale Tickets|Time Scale Tickets]] increased from 6 to 10 on every purchase and from 6 to 14 on first purchase. *Party System reworked. **Updated UI. **Parties are no longer invite only, now anyone can join them. **Added four settings: ***Maximum player level. ***Minimum player level. ***Setting that prevents people from joining the party. ***Setting that allows other party members to join the party. *New rewards added to main gamemodes. **[[Easy Mode]] ***[[Low Grade Crate]] with a 10% chance. ***[[Mid Grade Crate]] with a 2.5% chance. ***[[Currencies#Time Scale Tickets|Time Scale Ticket]] with a 2.5% chance. **[[Molten Mode]] ***[[Low Grade Crate]] with a 10% chance. ***[[Mid Grade Crate]] with a 2.5% chance. ***[[Currencies#Time Scale Tickets|Time Scale Ticket]] with a 2.5% chance. **[[Intermediate Mode]] ***[[Low Grade Crate]] with a 25% chance. ***[[Mid Grade Crate]] with a 10% chance. ***[[Currencies#Time Scale Tickets|Time Scale Ticket]] with a 10% chance. **[[Fallen Mode]] ***[[Low Grade Crate]] with a 30% chance. ***[[Mid Grade Crate]] with a 15% chance. ***[[Currencies#Time Scale Tickets|Time Scale Ticket]] with a 15% chance. **[[Hardcore Mode]] ***[[Low Grade Crate]] with a 50% chance. ***[[Mid Grade Crate]] with a 25% chance. ***[[Currencies#Time Scale Tickets|Time Scale Ticket]] with a 25% chance. *Tower pets now display more towers. **[[Military Base]] now shows the Level 3 unit. **[[Mercenary Base]] now shows the [[Rifleman]]. **Fixed {{Color|ColdFront|Ice Witch}} [[Accelerator]] not appearing. *[[High Grade Crate]] now gives eight consumables when opened instead of four. *Profile cards now appear when making a match through solo [[Matchmaking]]. *[[Patient Zero]]'s appearance changed. *Path arrows no longer disappear when the wave starts, now they disappear after reaching the exit. *[[Shield Health]] no longer deals damage to base health. *Fixed regenerated health from [[Health Regen]] not dealing damage to the base health. *Fixed {{Color|Premium|Classic}} [[Military Base]] skin not spawning [[Humvee]]s and being impossible to upgrade. *Fixed {{Color|Other|Spring Time}} [[Commander]] skin not being placeable and having no models. *Fixed [[Balloon]] not falling to the ground after losing all of its [[Shield Health]]. *Fixed [[Balloon]]'s balloons not popping when all of its [[Shield Health]] was lost. :In '''v1.22.1''' *Extended the [[PVP Test]] by three hours. *Fixed [[Tutorial]] giving rewards to new
